title: POW-001 Genesis Block Archive & Sponsor Data Model
description: Concrete JSON Schema data model for the POW-001 Genesis Block archive, enforcing canonical constraints: exactly 21 blocks, physical placement matching digital positions 1-21, Bitcoin payment (499 EUR base price, minimum 1 BTC confirmation), company branding assets, TXID, reservation timestamp, and SHA-256 Genesis record hash.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the POW-001 data model schema.

archive_id.description: Unique identifier for the Genesis archive instance.

total_supply.description: Total immutable supply of Genesis blocks, strictly constrained to exactly 21.

base_price_eur.description: Fixed pricing per Genesis block in EUR (499 EUR).

settlement_currency.description: Settlement currency exclusively denominated in Bitcoin.

required_btc_confirmations.description: Minimum Bitcoin on-chain confirmations required for finality (1 confirmation).

genesis_archive_hash.description: Root SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the entire 21 Genesis block cohort archive.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of Genesis archive compilation.

blocks.description: The complete cohort of exactly 21 Genesis sponsor blocks.

GenesisBlockRecord.description: Data record representing an individual POW-001 Genesis sponsor block.

digital_position.description: Digital archive index corresponding strictly to positions 1 through 21.

physical_placement.description: Physical chassis grid placement mapped directly to digital position.

grid_slot.description: Physical grid coordinate slot (1-21) on the hardware chassis.

matching_digital_position.description: Digital position counterpart (1-21), ensuring exact 1:1 physical-to-digital mapping.

chassis_id.description: Identifier of the physical machine chassis.

company_name.description: Legal or brand name of the sponsoring company.

canonical_url.description: Official canonical URL / website of the sponsoring company.

logo_asset.description: Vector or high-resolution branding asset for physical engraving and digital display.

asset_url.description: Permanent URL or IPFS/storage URI of the logo asset.

asset_type.description: MIME format or vector type of the logo asset.

sha256_hash.description: SHA-256 checksum of the logo asset file.

payment.description: Bitcoin payment settlement record for the block.

amount_eur.description: Fixed base price in EUR (499 EUR).

amount_btc.description: Amount paid in Bitcoin based on spot exchange lock.

payment_method.description: Bitcoin payment method used for settlement.

txid.description: Bitcoin Transaction ID (TXID) for on-chain settlement or payment preimage / invoice hash for Lightning.

confirmations.description: Number of Bitcoin network confirmations (minimum 1 confirmation required for on-chain settlement finality).

settlement_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the Bitcoin transaction achieved confirmation.

reservation_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the sponsor claim/reservation was initiated.

genesis_record_hash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the canonical Genesis block record.

status.description: Final lifecycle status of the Genesis sponsor block in the archive.
